units.source_text: 源氏公子换好衣服之后，便到西殿去看紫姬。

en.t: After Prince Genji had changed his clothes, he went to the western wing to see Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 但见室内已改成冬季装饰，气象焕然一新，华丽夺目。

en.t: He saw that the room had already been changed to winter decorations; everything looked fresh, splendid, and dazzling.

units.source_text: 几个美貌青年侍女和女童，都打扮得齐齐整整。

en.t: Several beautiful young ladies-in-waiting and little serving girls were all neatly and properly dressed.

units.source_text: 这都由紫姬的乳母少纳言调度布置，万事周到妥帖，精雅可喜。

en.t: All of this had been arranged under the direction of Lady Murasaki's nurse, Shonagon; everything was thoughtful, well ordered, refined, and pleasing.

units.source_text: 紫姬长得十分美丽，端详可爱。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had grown exceedingly beautiful, graceful, and lovable.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“许久不见，竟已变成一个大姑娘了！”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "I have not seen you for so long, and now you have become quite a grown young lady!"

units.source_text: 把小小的帷屏的垂布撩起，仔细一看，

en.t: He lifted the hanging cloth of the small curtain screen and looked closely,

units.source_text: 但见她侧向一旁，脉脉含羞地坐着，姿态之美，全无半点可以指摘。

en.t: and saw her sitting turned slightly to one side, shy and tender; the beauty of her bearing left not the slightest fault to find.

units.source_text: 源氏公子在灯光之下看她的侧影和头面，

en.t: Prince Genji gazed in the lamplight at her profile and the look of her hair and face,

units.source_text: 想道：“她竟长得和我所魂思梦想的那个人毫无两样呢！”

en.t: and thought, "She has grown to look exactly like the person I have longed for even in my dreams!"

units.source_text: 他心中异常欢慰。

en.t: His heart was filled with extraordinary joy and comfort.

units.source_text: 便走近紫姬身边，对她罄谈别离中相思相念之情。

en.t: He then went close to Lady Murasaki and poured out to her all the longing he had felt during their separation.

units.source_text: 他说：“这期间种种详情，容后徐徐细说。

en.t: He said, "I will tell you all the details of what has happened during this time slowly and fully later.

units.source_text: 我刚从丧家出来，身蒙不祥之气，暂且到那边去休息一会，再来看你。

en.t: I have just come from a house of mourning and am still touched by its impurity, so I will go over there for a short rest and then come back to see you.

units.source_text: 今后我将长住在此，天天和你厮伴。

en.t: From now on I will live here for a long while and spend every day with you.

units.source_text: 你会讨厌我么？”语调和蔼可亲。

en.t: Will you come to dislike me?" His tone was gentle and affectionate.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母听了心中欢喜，然而还是担心，

en.t: The nurse Shonagon was happy at heart when she heard this, but she was still worried,

units.source_text: 她想：“公子有许多身份高贵的情人，

en.t: and thought, "The prince has many lovers of high rank,

units.source_text: 生怕其中有一个讨厌的人，会出来代替葵姬当正夫人，如之奈何！”

en.t: and what should we do if some disagreeable woman among them were to appear and take Lady Aoi's place as his principal wife!"

units.source_text: 心中不免厌恶。

en.t: She could not help feeling repelled at the thought.
